fixes.explanation: Bronze it is, baker! The altar is overlaid with bronze, and the instruction says, "Make all its utensils of bronze…" (Exodus 27:3). Then the grate is bronze mesh with bronze rings (Exodus 27:4), the poles are overlaid with bronze (Exodus 27:6), and even the tent pegs are bronze (Exodus 27:19). Pots, shovels, bowls, forks, firepans, all one metal, a perfectly matching set. My spoons have never matched once, and I've stopped asking why.

problems.problem: The apron joke does not connect clearly to the altar materials. Mixing up one apron with itself makes the comparison hard to follow.
